name: Zacess Warm Light
description: Dark brown on warm paper with earthy amber, rust, olive and teal, a gentler theme for anyone who finds high contrast too intense.
toml:
# the Zacess Warm Light theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1
# a gentler pair: the themes hold it to a 4.5:1 text floor rather than 7:1, so the profile states
# the same floor and is checked against it

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess Warm Light"
id = "zacess-warm-light"
description = "Dark brown on warm paper with earthy amber, rust, olive and teal, a gentler theme for anyone who finds high contrast too intense."
appearance = "light"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 4.5
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 4.5
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#f4ead5"
foreground = "#342410"
surface = "#ece1ca"
surface_alt = "#e4d8be"
muted = "#483b2c"
border = "#7e6f5f"
accent = "#6d3b02"
accent_foreground = "#f4ead5"
link = "#6d3b02"
focus_ring = "#6d3b02"
cursor = "#5b1301"
cursor_text = "#f4ead5"
selection_background = "#215779"
selection_foreground = "#f4ead5"
selection_soft = "#a0d2fe"
line_highlight = "#d0cec0"
error = "#710205"
warning = "#623d02"
info = "#01385c"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#832a01"
control = "#760244"
function = "#744f01"
type = "#045247"
variable = "#342410"
parameter = "#723902"
property = "#02318d"
string = "#04523a"
number = "#962b70"
comment = "#625240"
operator = "#342410"
tag = "#930e04"
attribute = "#8c4105"
regex = "#064045"
invalid = "#62020b"
added = "#08651b"
removed = "#790411"
changed = "#04488d"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#342410", "#8c1a16", "#275200", "#6a4603",
    "#014b79", "#742c60", "#05514d", "#574e44",
    "#60574c", "#a4332b", "#386616", "#845701",
    "#115f93", "#8a4074", "#066662", "#342410",
]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-warm-light.toml (Zacess Warm Light)
     224 pairs against text 4.5:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 4.5:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest syntax.added #08651b on selection_soft #a0d2fe: 4.55:1
